ato.error.cancelled:description:
The user cancelled the bake. Temporary assets on disk were kept. CPU/GPU/memory were released.
Details: {0}
ato.error.cancelled:hint: Run the bake again when you are ready. No need to clean temp files.
ato.error.multiple: More than one Avatar Texture Optimizer component
ato.error.multiple:description: An avatar and its children may only have a single AvatarTextureOptimizer. Bake aborted.
ato.error.multiple:hint: Delete extra components until only one remains on the avatar root.
ato.error.notRoot: Component is not on the avatar root
ato.error.notRoot:description: AvatarTextureOptimizer must be on the same GameObject as VRCAvatarDescriptor. Found on '{0}'.
ato.error.notRoot:hint: Move the component to the avatar root.
ato.error.noDescriptor:description: The object that hosts AvatarTextureOptimizer must also have a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.noDescriptor:hint: Add VRCAvatarDescriptor, or move this component to the avatar root.
ato.report.done:hint: Open the log (lines starting with [ATO]) for per-stage timings.
ato.warn.generic:hint: The bake continued with a safe fallback. See the description.
ato.report.summary: ATO {0} ms | atlases={1} islands={2} dedup={3} | {4} → {5} ({6:0.0}% saved)
ato.ui.help: This tool shrinks and atlases avatar textures by looking at mesh UVs — not material parameters. Hang exactly one copy on the avatar root (the object with VRCAvatarDescriptor). Then bake or upload as usual. Default settings are safe; open Advanced only if you know you need them.
ato.ui.needDescriptor: This GameObject has no VRCAvatarDescriptor. Move the component to the avatar root.
ato.ui.onlyOne: Multiple Avatar Texture Optimizer components found. Keep only one on the avatar root.
ato.ui.generateAtlas.tip: On: pack UV islands into atlases, drop unused texels, rewrite UVs. Off: only scale whole textures, keep original UVs.
ato.ui.preset.tip: Named presets overwrite the numeric thresholds. Custom is never overwritten. Default is High.
ato.ui.whitelist.tip: Any object type (mesh, material, texture, clip, GameObject…). All textures referenced by these objects skip every optimization.
ato.ui.npot.tip: Use 64 px steps instead of powers of two. Compatible with MipStreaming and Crunch. Unsupported compressors (e.g. PVRTC) are removed from the enum.
ato.ui.formatIllegal: This format is not legal for the current class/platform. It will fall back at bake.
ato.ui.language.tip: Auto follows NDMF. Drop extra *.json files into Localization/ to add languages. Missing keys fall back to English.
